proof_rules.implication: exact set containment on half-lines; same venue, event, cutoff and settlement source required; >= vs > at equal strikes does not imply
proof_rules.basket: pairwise disjoint and covering on a grid inferred from rung boundaries; gaps wider than one step refused; exactly one rung settles YES

fee_model: Kalshi quadratic taker, rate x contracts x P x (1-P), ceiled to the cent on the whole order; per-market rate read from the venue; unknown rate refuses
execution_model: TAKER_SEQUENTIAL not yet modelled; current figures assume ATOMIC_THEORETICAL fills and are therefore an upper bound
sizing_rule: marginal: take sets while the marginal pair/basket cost is below the payoff per set; never average cost
pre_registration_note: These thresholds are fixed before forward evaluation. Changing any of them increments strategy_version and restarts the forward sample; prior data becomes development sample only.
